lines.speaker: npc.conductor
lines.text: Ah, you're awake. The waystation ahead went silent three cycles ago.

lines.speaker: npc.conductor
lines.text: The Express can't depart without its navigation beacon. Will you take a look?

lines.speaker: npc.conductor
lines.text: Splendid. Mind the outer platform. Something has been nesting there.

lines.speaker: npc.conductor
lines.text: A choir of hollow things. They sing until the lights go out. Please, be careful.
